Synthetic FBPK v2 wrapper containing an Android sparse RAW chunk containing the official AOSP boot v4 fixture. Wrapper fields follow formats/fbpack.py and AOSP libsparse/sparse_format.h; hashes are computed with Python hashlib from the inputs. The nested boot producer and original payload provenance are recorded in tests/fixture_sources/boot. This checks content-based recursion across all three Rust ports without shared dispatch edits.
